figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. In vitro characterization of PezW. A, PezW-catalyzed halogenation reactions using NaCl as a halogen donor (i: boiled PezW incubated
with 1; ii: PezW incubated with 1 and NaCl; iii: boiled PezW incubated with 2; iv: PezW incubated with 2 and NaCl); B: Incubation of PezW with
1 and different coenzymes; C: 1 incubated with PezW and different halogen donors (i: boiled PezW; ii: NaF; iii: NaCl; iv: NaBr; v: NaI); D: 2
incubated with PezW and different halogen donors (i: boiled PezW; ii: NaCl; iii: NaBr; iv: NaI).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. Modeled structure of PezW and mutagenesis results. A: The AlphaFold-predicted structure of PezW. PezW is presented as a palecyan
cartoon model, and docked FAD (yellow), NAD+ (blue), and substrate 1/2 (orange/slate) are indicated by sticks. B: Interactions between PezW
and substrate 1/2. C: Relative conversion of chlorinated phenazines by PezW and its variants with 1 (see Table S8 for the details). D: Relative
conversion of brominated phenazines by PezW and its variants with 2 (see Table S9 for the details). E: Relative conversion of brominated
phenazines by different I54 variants with 2. All assays were performed in triplicate and the results are presented as average ± SD. The conversion of
WT was defined as 100%. The relative conversion = (conversion of variants/conversion of WT) × 100%.
